notes_for_editor: No story written: the only fetched source naming this tower is the index entry (name and county), which cannot reach the 120-word floor without padding. Checked and empty: Wikipedia Bell, Florida (no tower or lookout mention); the NRHP Gilchrist County list (no tower); the cached Florida lists on nhlr.org and firetower.org (no Bell); firelookout.org Florida page ('Data being compiled'). Search snippets (not fetched, so not cited) point to a USGS map feature named 'Bell Fire Tower' and to a 222 ft antenna structure registered to Gilchrist County with a 2000 construction date, which is probably a communications tower. A TopoQuest lookout near Yard Pond sits at a different location from the record's coordinates. Needs a Florida Forest Service, Florida Master Site File or county historical record before a story is possible.
